UserAction.Description: Go to Inventory management > Inquiries and reports > On-hand list.

Apply the following filters: Enter a filter value of "GA0002" on the "Item number" field using the "contains" filter operator; Enter a filter value of "2" on the "Site" field using the "contains" filter operator; Enter a filter value of "11-UND" on the "Warehouse" field using the "is not" filter operator; Enter a filter value of "000002" on the "Serial number" field using the "contains" filter operator; Enter a filter value of "" on the "Batch number" field using the "begins with" filter operator; Enter a filter value of "abc" on the "Search name" field using the "does not contain" filter operator
